facts.text: Audrey mentions that keeping dogs active in the city is key to their happiness.

evidence.quote: There are lots of ways to keep them happy in the city. Make sure to socialize and exercise them daily.

facts.text: Audrey provides an image of a dog playing fetch in the park as an example of an activity that dogs enjoy.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of them playing fetch in the park - they love it!

facts.text: Audrey describes various activities she uses to keep her dogs mentally stimulated, including puzzles, training, and hide-and-seek.

evidence.quote: We give them lots of activities to keep them busy - puzzles, training, hide-and-seek - they love it all!

facts.text: Audrey provides an image of a dog playing with a frisbee in a room as another example of an activity that dogs enjoy.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of a dog playing with a frisbee in a room.
